'''Gagesk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was an armor vendor in [[Oradam village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TOR" />
